meta.title: Audio Trimmer - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Trim audio files by selecting start and end times. Download as WAV. No upload.
mergeAtLeast: Add at least {count} files to merge
clippingWarning: Volume above 100% may cause clipping and distortion in the exported audio.
webmNote: WebM/Opus uses browser MediaRecorder — bitrate and sample rate are browser-controlled.
gateDesc: Silences signals below the threshold. Attack controls how quickly the gate opens; Release controls how quickly it closes.
rnnoiseDesc: Deep learning model trained on voice. Removes background noise while preserving speech clarity.
rnnoiseSrWarning: Your audio is {sr} kHz. RNNoise works best at 48 kHz — it will be automatically resampled.
rnnoiseFirstRun: First run downloads AI model (~100 KB)
steps_audio-trim_1Desc: Select an audio file (MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC, FLAC) to trim. The waveform visualizes your audio so you can see exactly where to cut.
steps_audio-trim_2Desc: Drag the start and end handles on the waveform to select the portion to keep. Preview the trimmed segment before committing to ensure it sounds right.
steps_audio-trim_3Desc: Click Trim to cut your audio to the selected range. Download the trimmed file — perfect for ringtones, podcast clips, and removing unwanted sections.
desc: Trim audio files by selecting start and end times. Download as WAV. No upload.
